text:
Priya: Heads-up — LyraHealth wants a 10-day POC (6d burst + 4d reserved). Procurement will only issue one PO and says MSA needs exec-sig before PO. Timeline: end of week.
Ben (Legal): We saw their MSA/DPA redlines. They inserted a broad no-caching clause and a SOC2 addendum ask. Can't accept as-is.
Arman (Presales): Pricing snapshot:
```
burst-6d: $6,500
reserved-4d-eq: $2,400
trial-tokens: 40k
```
If cache disabled, tokens +25-30%.
Jill (Finance): Single PO ok if PO includes our legal name, EIN, remittance address and billing contact. Need two invoice lines.
po-assistant: PO check: missing vendor EIN and signature block. Template: https://redwood.co/po-template.
Priya: @Ben can we do PO-first with an Appendix scoping cache to ephemeral in-memory KV and a security signoff?
Ben (Legal): Yes — propose Appendix: ephemeral in-memory cache only, retention <=14 days, expires at POC end, no subprocessor transfers. If Sales Ops flags "PO-first - appendix pending" and Security OKs SOC2 addendum, we can accept PO-first.
Arman (Presales): I'll prepare two order-form options (A PO-first with extra trial tokens, B exec-sign-first at current rates) and upload.
Jill (Finance): I'll validate GL codes and invoice mapping when uploaded.
Priya: Plan: upload draft now, request Sales Ops e-sign fast-track if exec required, ping Security for SOC2 quick review. Back shortly. :thumbsup:
